review_candidates.description: Desk Side Support Field Engineer Overview NSC Global is looking for Level 1 Field Service Technicians to deliver on site technical support for customer systems. The role covers on site hardware troubleshooting, repair and replacement, diagnostics, service call updates, parts handling and customer communication, in line with agreed service levels and established field service procedures. Technicians attend customer locations, validate reported faults, complete the intervention and provide accurate updates throughout. The position requires sound technical troubleshooting ability, professional communication, close adherence to process and the ability to work to deadlines driven by service level agreements. Responsibilities Attend customer sites within agreed service windows and complete each intervention to the required standard. Perform on site troubleshooting, diagnostics, hardware repair and component replacement across desktops, laptops and related client hardware. Validate warranty status, asset identification and diagnostic findings before completing any repair. Apply approved diagnostic tools and methods, including built in diagnostics, LED fault codes and structured logical troubleshooting. Confirm receipt of service calls, manage estimated arrival updates and maintain accurate records in the required systems, with arrival updates within 15 minutes and closure within 30 minutes of service completion. Generate electronic service reports through the designated field service platform and obtain customer sign off following each intervention. Reinstall BIOS, drivers and operating systems where instructed and where approved recovery media is available. Troubleshoot hardware related networking faults falling within the scope of the service call. Order additional parts through the approved process, following completion of documented troubleshooting. Collect, manage, package, label and return defective or unused parts within the required process and timescales. Keep customers informed throughout the intervention, including next steps, repeat visits and parts requirements. Escalate unusual incidents immediately, including customer dissatisfaction, damage, missing equipment, unsafe environments or any issue affecting service delivery. Comply with all electrostatic discharge, safety and documented procedural requirements, and display the required identification while on customer sites. Report process deviations and quality issues, and contribute to continuous improvement. Qualifications Experience in Level 1 technical support, field service, desktop support, break/fix support or a comparable customer facing IT support role. Sound understanding of PC, laptop and client hardware components. Working knowledge of operating systems, BIOS, drivers, hardware fault isolation and basic networking principles. Ability to follow structured diagnostic processes and document troubleshooting steps accurately. Confident communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non technical customers. Ability to work independently at customer sites while observing agreed process, safety and escalation procedures. Strong time management across appointments, travel and service level expectations. High attention to detail in ticket updates, notes, parts handling and service reporting. Fluent written and spoken knowledge of the local language of the assigned territory, sufficient for direct customer contact on site. Proficient written and spoken English, sufficient for technical documentation, service reporting and communication with the wider support organisation. A valid driving licence and access to a personal vehicle for travel to customer locations. CompTIA A+ certification is desirable, particularly for technicians new to this area of client hardware support. Tools and equipment Smartphone or tablet compatible with the required field service applications. Reliable internet connectivity suitable for field service updates and application use. Access to an electrostatic discharge kit and standard computer repair tools. Bootable USB key and the tools required for system disassembly and component replacement. Own vehicle available for daily travel between customer sites, with secure storage for tools and parts. Compliance and security Successful completion of all required criminal background checks prior to attending any customer site. Authorisation to work in the assigned territory in accordance with applicable law. Completion of all required authorisations and product, security, privacy and process training before performing service calls, and maintenance of that authorisation thereafter. Training is provided. Compliance with customer site access, security, privacy, safety and conduct requirements, and with all policies relating to confidential information, customer data and incident escalation. Technicians must be free of drugs and alcohol when performing service activity.

review_candidates.description: Description Are you passionate about e-commerce? Are you looking to join a community of business development professionals that support the growth of small and medium sized businesses? Or want to solve complex business problems with strategic impact for a population of selling partners? Amazon, one of the world's leaders in e-commerce is looking for a Key Account Manager to join its Third-Party Marketplace team based in Cairo, Egypt. Working in a dynamic business development environment, your role will be focused on contributing to new acquisition through hunting, specifically phone/email-based prospecting and recruiting of new merchants who can bring their competitive range of products, pricing and availability to Amazon. You will also work with merchants as an account manager – helping them to launch and grow their on Amazon by ensuring they understand Amazon’s products, services, systems and tools. You will be responsible for using feedback from the merchants to identify opportunities to improve Amazon’s products, services, processes, systems and tools. Lastly, Lead a variety of projects that drive growth and improve Customer Experience and Seller Experience in Egypt. Partner with regional teams to drive automation and scalability across organization. To be successful in this role you must have superior analytical, communication, and presentation skills. Operating in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, working autonomously and taking full control & responsibility for achieving business objectives. Key job responsibilities Identify, prospect, and recruit high-potential selling partners to Souq.com Marketplace. Effectively prioritize and lead a portfolio of selling partners to realize the product family's opportunities and goals (both Inputs/Outputs metrics). Be your seller partners' consultant, providing them with data-driven insights and advice to optimize their success and grow their business Identify key business opportunities of your categories via spotting popular brands, trends, and pricing to ensure managing the portfolio toward a growth plan Conduct deep dive analysis on issues affecting selling partners' business performance and provide the Voice of the Seller as an input into product development and process improvement. Work closely with selling partners, educating them about Amazon’s/Souq's high standards of Delivery and Customer Experience Track and report business development results, analyze data, interpret reports and information, and publish recommendations & action plans for your portfolio of selling partners. Partner with multiple stakeholders to align programs and initiatives to help drive the growth of your selling partners portfolio. Lead a variety of projects that drive growth and improve Customer Experience and Seller Experience in Egypt. Partner with regional teams to drive automation and scalability across organization. review_candidates.title: Platform Manager, Digital Directory & Membership Growth
review_candidates.description: Levelzi is hiring: Head of Platform, Online Business Directory Remote · 90-day contract, with possible extension · Full-time About the Role We're looking for a Head of Platform to own the launch and growth of a newly built online business directory. This is a hands-on, remote contract role for a strong project manager, organizer, and galvanizer who can drive progress sprint by sprint through launch and beyond. About the Platform The platform lists verified businesses within a defined community, roughly 70% brick-and-mortar and 30% services. It's built around search, so someone looking for a type of business finds the platform and its listed businesses. The site is built and ready to launch, and we need someone to own it, get it launched, and grow it. Responsibilities Launch and project management: Plan and run the work in sprints across three phases, pre-launch, launch, and post-launch. Set priorities, run check-ins, and keep progress visible. Revenue generation: Build and execute strategies to earn revenue, including free and premium listing tiers, promoted listings, banner advertising, and website development services for listed businesses. Engagement and growth: Recruit new businesses to the directory and grow and engage membership. Over time, help shape community offerings such as workshops and networking events. Process and validation: Build and maintain a reliable process for validating new applicants. Keep the database clean, accurate, and current. Platform coordination: Work with developers or vendors, turning needs into clear requirements and prioritizing fixes and improvements. Stakeholder coordination: Work with leadership, volunteers, and listed businesses to keep decisions moving and remove blockers. What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days Pre-launch: A launch plan, stakeholder map, and vendor schedule are in place. The validation process is documented, and existing listings are audited and cleaned up. Launch: The platform is live, with at least one paid offering defined and pitched to businesses. Post-launch: Listings are growing, the first paid placements or ads are sold, and leadership receives a monthly metrics report. What We're Looking For Strong project management and organizational skills, with a track record of shipping on deadlines Experience in data management, digital marketing, or membership growth strategies Strong analytical skills for managing a database and growing revenue A commitment to keeping membership data complete and accurate Experience coordinating volunteers, part-time teams, or community stakeholders Comfort working with web developers or vendors (coding not required) Excellent written and spoken English Nice to Have Experience with online directories, marketplaces, or membership platforms Familiarity with WordPress or a similar CMS, Google Analytics, and Search Console How to Apply Apply at www.levelzi.com
